segments.text: Confession of Faith twenty-seven, paragraph two
There is, in every sacrament, a spiritual relation, or sacramental union, between the sign and the thing signified:
whence it comes to pass, that the names and effects of the one are attributed to the other.
Larger Catechism one hundred and sixty-three
What are the parts of a sacrament
The parts of a sacrament are two; the one an outward and sensible sign, used according to Christ's own appointment; the other an inward and spiritual grace thereby signified.
